02Development direction

Questions that shape the next iteration.

Illustrative product intentions for discussion, not a committed roadmap, release schedule, or promise of functionality.

  1. 01 / Validate the workflow

    Does the analyst have the right context?

    Use demo feedback to understand which asset, event, and evidence views help a reviewer reach a better-supported decision.

  2. 02 / Establish feasibility

    What would a real environment require?

    Explore data-source quality, access boundaries, integration needs, deployment responsibilities, and operating constraints before defining an implementation scope.

  3. 03 / Define readiness

    What must be verified before evaluation?

    Agree acceptance criteria, limitations, governance, support expectations, and commercial terms. Any future evaluation or release requires separate confirmation.
